'use agent';

import { useModel } from '@flue/runtime';
import { useCloudflareEmail } from '@illuwa-soft/flue-cloudflare-email';
import { email } from '../email-channel.ts';
import { installLocalModel } from '../local-model.ts';

installLocalModel(true);

/** Consume the channel without application-specific retrieval or reply tools. / 앱 전용 조회·답장 도구 없이 채널을 소비합니다. */
export function EmailAssistant() {
	useModel('email-local/assistant');
	useCloudflareEmail(email);
	return 'Read the delivered email and reply using its messageRef.';
}
